versions.changelog:
- Added a platform × endpoint support matrix section, clearly listing which endpoints are available for each platform.
- Updated and expanded endpoint parameter details in the GET /v1/search section.
- Clarified and enhanced descriptions for async polling, rate limits, and partial failures.
- Documented known limitations, including pagination, ID resolution, and platform gaps.
- Changed the Hermes metadata category tag from "travel" to "integrations".
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of the vrbo-rentals skill.
- Search and discover Vrbo vacation rentals by location, dates, and occupancy using the StayingAPI unified schema.
- Returns results comparable across Vrbo, Airbnb, Booking.com, and Google Hotels.
- Requires a StayingAPI key for all API requests.
- User-invocable and designed for streamlined vacation rental discovery.
- No additional dependencies; only internet access required.
